[[File:Bendu_Statue_front_view.jpg|thumb|right|330px|Red and yellow prayer flags around the Bendu Statue of Ando Prime]]
The '''prayer flag''' was a religious artifact distinguished by a series of rectangular fabrics of varying colours hanging over passageways. After the practices of the [[Frangawl Cult]] were outlawed on [[Bardotta]], [[Bardottan]]s covered up Frangawl temples with prayer flags,<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> including in the [[Bardotta Capital City]].<ref name="Disappeared I">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part I}}</ref> Prayer flags were hung throughout the [[Bendu Village]] in the [[Andobi Mountains/Legends|Andobi Mountains]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], centered around the [[Bendu Statue|statue]] of the [[Order of Dai Bendu]].<ref name="Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the real-world, the [[Wikipedia:Prayer flag|prayer flags]] of [[Wikipedia:Tibet|Tibet]] are colorful cloths that traditionally promote peace, wisdom, compassion, and strength as they flow in the wind. Originating from [[Wikipedia:Bon|native Tibetan religion]], prayer flags are prominently used in [[Wikipedia:Tibetan Buddhism|Tibetan Buddhism]],<ref name="Tibet">{{WebCite|url=https://tibetrelieffund.co.uk/tibetan-prayer-flags|text=What are Tibetan Prayer Flags?|work=Tibet Relief Fund|archivedate=20230121182442}}</ref>
